digest.component_or_area: live jira dc harness provenance test
propositions: The provenance test asserts a raw Jira key (RBJNAZV-1) against a substring of json.dumps(ticket), but the local ticket id is lowercased (jira-rbjnazv-1) and the raw key does not appear in the ticket payload, making the assertion fail even when inbound create works correctly

The test assertion scans the entire ticket JSON for the raw key string rather than matching the exact local id derived by _jira_key_to_local_id, conflating incidental matches with the actual correspondence
The Jira key to local id correspondence is recorded in the binding store and not in the ticket payload itself, so the binding store must be explicitly asserted to verify the round-trip
The test must be rewritten to assert exact id equality using _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally assert the binding store maps that local id to remote_key

Prior masking defects (empty store appearing as converged, PAT-cap bug at setup, oracle defect) made this test's failure non-informative about whether inbound creation actually worked until all three are fixed
